text_original: Collector summary (not verbatim source text): Physical buttons/knobs for climate control — not available: Air conditioning and ventilation controlled via the touch function on the 14.9" control display; physical buttons reduced. Notes: BMW says remaining buttons are kept only where they are ideal for fast operation; the release does not list which climate functions (if any, e.g. defrost) keep a hard key. Same interior in EU and CN.
